subject: paradoxical frog
title: This Frog Gets Smaller When It Grows Up

scenes.text: This frog gets smaller as it grows up.
It's the paradoxical frog, from South America, and its tadpole can reach nearly eight inches long.
That's several times longer than the adult frog it will become.
In the pool where it lives, there are few fish to eat it, so the tadpole keeps growing.
Then it turns into a frog, loses its huge tail, and ends up about a quarter of its former length.

description:
This frog gets smaller as it grows up.
The paradoxical frog's tadpole can grow nearly eight inches long, then it shrinks to roughly a quarter or a third of that length when it turns into a frog.
What's the strangest way you've seen an animal grow up?
first_comment: Bonus: the name paradoxical comes from exactly this. Early scientists thought the giant tadpole was a different, bigger animal. Would you have guessed?
